# chalk_cluster_host_pool (Resource)

Manages a host pool scoped to a Chalk cluster. Host pools provide the hosts that Chalk Compute workloads run on.

**Required permissions:** `deploy.create` *(team-scoped)*

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A host pool scoped to a cluster, shared by every environment on that cluster.
#
# Pools either hold a fixed number of hosts (min_hosts = max_hosts) or scale down
# to zero when idle (min_hosts = 0). idle_timeout is required in the scaling case
# and must not be set for fixed-size pools.

resource "chalk_cluster_host_pool" "workers" {
  cluster_id = chalk_managed_cluster.example.id

  name         = "workers"
  min_hosts    = 0
  max_hosts    = 8
  idle_timeout = "10m"
  cpu          = "4"
  memory       = "8Gi"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster this host pool belongs to.
- `cpu` (String) CPU resources for each host, e.g. `4`.
- `max_hosts` (Number) Maximum number of hosts in the pool.
- `memory` (String) Memory resources for each host, e.g. `8Gi`.
- `min_hosts` (Number) Minimum number of hosts to keep running. Must be either `0` or equal to `max_hosts`.
- `name` (String) Name of the host pool. Must be a valid DNS label.

### Optional

- `idle_timeout` (String) How long an idle host is kept before being scaled down, e.g. `5m` or `1h30m`. Required when `min_hosts` is less than `max_hosts`, and must not be set when they are equal. Minimum of `1m`.
- `machine_family` (String) Machine family for this pool's hosts to run on. Defaults to an internally chosen family when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The host pool id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Cluster host pools are imported by their cluster id and host pool id.
terraform import chalk_cluster_host_pool.workers cluster-id-abc123/hostpool-id-def456
```
